text:
Brandt Clarke is having the season people projected when the Kings took him eighth overall in 2021. At 23 he has 11 points in 15 games, 5 on the power play, and NHL.com quoted him as "happy to be a key contributor" with a leadership role ahead.

The five-on-five impact is the striking part. Los Angeles takes 59% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, 15 points better than without him. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking backs that up: last season he was 99th percentile among defensemen in primary shot assists and stopped 16% of the entries aimed at him, against a typical 11%.

Two parts of his line will move. He is shooting 13% on few shots, so his 3 goals will slow. But the Kings have scored 5.3 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, which should swing back into more assists. Our range has him around 45 points; we think the play-driving is the part that lasts.
headline: Clarke is running the Kings' attack from the back
